preset/fib.source:
# Fibonacci: computes fib(20) = 6765 and prints it in decimal.
# Decimal conversion uses repeated subtraction, because the core has no multiply or divide.

        .text
_start:
        lui     sp, 0x11        # stack pointer: top of the 4 KiB data memory
        li      s0, 20          # n
        li      a1, 0           # fib(i)
        li      a2, 1           # fib(i+1)
1:      beqz    s0, 2f
        add     a3, a1, a2
        mv      a1, a2
        mv      a2, a3
        addi    s0, s0, -1
        j       1b
2:      mv      a0, a1
        call    print_uint
        li      a0, 10          # newline
        call    putc
        j       finish

# print_uint: a0 = unsigned value, printed in decimal (no newline).
print_uint:
        addi    sp, sp, -16
        sw      ra, 12(sp)
        li      t3, 0           # digits pushed so far
        li      t4, 10
1:      mv      t0, a0          # t0 = value still to divide
        li      t1, 0           # t1 = quotient
2:      bltu    t0, t4, 3f
        addi    t0, t0, -10
        addi    t1, t1, 1
        j       2b
3:      addi    t0, t0, 48      # remainder -> ASCII digit
        add     t2, sp, t3
        sb      t0, 0(t2)
        addi    t3, t3, 1
        mv      a0, t1
        bnez    a0, 1b
4:      addi    t3, t3, -1      # digits come out last-first
        add     t2, sp, t3
        lbu     a0, 0(t2)
        call    putc
        bnez    t3, 4b
        lw      ra, 12(sp)
        addi    sp, sp, 16
        ret

# putc: a0 = byte to print.
putc:   lui     t1, 0x20
        sb      a0, 0(t1)
        ret

# finish: report PASS to the harness and halt.
finish: li      t0, 1
        lui     t1, 0x20
        sw      t0, 4(t1)
halt:   j       halt

preset/hello.source:
# Hello, TinyCPU: prints a greeting through the CONSOLE register, then reports PASS.
# CONSOLE is at 0x0002_0000 (a store prints its low byte); TOHOST at 0x0002_0004 (1 = PASS).

        .text
_start:
        la      a0, msg         # a0 = address of the string
        call    print_str
        li      t0, 1
        lui     t1, 0x20        # t1 = 0x0002_0000
        sw      t0, 4(t1)       # TOHOST = 1: halt, PASS
halt:   j       halt

# print_str: a0 = address of a NUL-terminated string.
print_str:
        lui     t1, 0x20        # CONSOLE
1:      lbu     t0, 0(a0)
        beqz    t0, 2f
        sb      t0, 0(t1)
        addi    a0, a0, 1
        j       1b
2:      ret

        .data
msg:    .asciz  "Hello, TinyCPU!\n"

preset/memcpy.source:
# Copies 16 words with a byte-by-byte memcpy, checks every word, and prints OK or FAIL.

        .text
_start:
        lui     sp, 0x11
        la      a0, dst
        la      a1, src
        li      a2, 64          # bytes
        call    memcpy
        la      t0, dst
        la      t1, src
        li      t2, 16          # words left to compare
1:      beqz    t2, ok
        lw      t3, 0(t0)
        lw      t4, 0(t1)
        bne     t3, t4, bad
        addi    t0, t0, 4
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        addi    t2, t2, -1
        j       1b
ok:     la      a0, s_ok
        call    print_str
        j       finish
bad:    la      a0, s_bad
        call    print_str
        li      t0, 3           # exit code 3 = mismatch
        lui     t1, 0x20
        sw      t0, 4(t1)
halt:   j       halt

# memcpy: a0 = dst, a1 = src, a2 = byte count.
memcpy: beqz    a2, 2f
1:      lbu     t0, 0(a1)
        sb      t0, 0(a0)
        addi    a0, a0, 1
        addi    a1, a1, 1
        addi    a2, a2, -1
        bnez    a2, 1b
2:      ret

# print_str: a0 = address of a NUL-terminated string.
print_str:
        lui     t1, 0x20
1:      lbu     t0, 0(a0)
        beqz    t0, 2f
        sb      t0, 0(t1)
        addi    a0, a0, 1
        j       1b
2:      ret

# finish: report PASS to the harness and halt.
finish: li      t0, 1
        lui     t1, 0x20
        sw      t0, 4(t1)
halt2:  j       halt2

        .data
        .align  2
src:    .word   0x00000001, 0xdeadbeef, 0x80000000, 0x7fffffff
        .word   0xffffffff, 0x12345678, 0x0badf00d, 0xcafebabe
        .word   0x0f0f0f0f, 0xf0f0f0f0, 0x00ff00ff, 0xff00ff00
        .word   0x13579bdf, 0x2468ace0, 0x55aa55aa, 0xaa55aa55
dst:    .space  64
s_ok:   .asciz  "OK\n"
s_bad:  .asciz  "FAIL\n"

preset/primes.source:
# Sieve of Eratosthenes up to 60: prints every prime.
# p*p is computed by repeated addition, because the core has no multiply.

        .text
_start:
        lui     sp, 0x11
        la      s0, sieve       # s0 = sieve base (one byte per number)
        li      s1, 60          # s1 = limit
        li      t0, 0
1:      bgt     t0, s1, 2f      # clear sieve[0..limit]
        add     t1, s0, t0
        sb      zero, 0(t1)
        addi    t0, t0, 1
        j       1b
2:      li      s2, 2           # s2 = p
3:      mv      t4, s2          # t3 = p*p by adding p, p times
        li      t3, 0
4:      beqz    t4, 5f
        add     t3, t3, s2
        addi    t4, t4, -1
        j       4b
5:      bgt     t3, s1, 8f      # p*p past the limit: sieving done
        add     t1, s0, s2
        lbu     t5, 0(t1)
        bnez    t5, 7f          # p is composite: skip it
        mv      t0, t3          # mark p*p, p*p+p, ...
6:      bgt     t0, s1, 7f
        add     t1, s0, t0
        li      t5, 1
        sb      t5, 0(t1)
        add     t0, t0, s2
        j       6b
7:      addi    s2, s2, 1
        j       3b
8:      li      s2, 2           # print the primes
9:      bgt     s2, s1, 11f
        add     t1, s0, s2
        lbu     t5, 0(t1)
        bnez    t5, 10f
        mv      a0, s2
        call    print_uint
        li      a0, 32
        call    putc
10:     addi    s2, s2, 1
        j       9b
11:     li      a0, 10
        call    putc
        j       finish

# print_uint: a0 = unsigned value, printed in decimal (no newline).
print_uint:
        addi    sp, sp, -16
        sw      ra, 12(sp)
        li      t3, 0
        li      t4, 10
1:      mv      t0, a0
        li      t1, 0
2:      bltu    t0, t4, 3f
        addi    t0, t0, -10
        addi    t1, t1, 1
        j       2b
3:      addi    t0, t0, 48
        add     t2, sp, t3
        sb      t0, 0(t2)
        addi    t3, t3, 1
        mv      a0, t1
        bnez    a0, 1b
4:      addi    t3, t3, -1
        add     t2, sp, t3
        lbu     a0, 0(t2)
        call    putc
        bnez    t3, 4b
        lw      ra, 12(sp)
        addi    sp, sp, 16
        ret

# putc: a0 = byte to print.
putc:   lui     t1, 0x20
        sb      a0, 0(t1)
        ret

# finish: report PASS to the harness and halt.
finish: li      t0, 1
        lui     t1, 0x20
        sw      t0, 4(t1)
halt:   j       halt

        .data
sieve:  .space  61

preset/sort.source:
# Bubble sort of 12 words in data memory, then print them separated by spaces.

        .text
_start:
        lui     sp, 0x11
        la      s0, array       # s0 = base of the array
        li      s1, 12          # s1 = element count
        addi    s2, s1, -1      # s2 = passes left
1:      blez    s2, 5f
        li      t0, 0           # i
        mv      t1, s0          # t1 = &array[i]
2:      bge     t0, s2, 4f
        lw      a1, 0(t1)
        lw      a2, 4(t1)
        ble     a1, a2, 3f      # already in order
        sw      a2, 0(t1)
        sw      a1, 4(t1)
3:      addi    t0, t0, 1
        addi    t1, t1, 4
        j       2b
4:      addi    s2, s2, -1
        j       1b
5:      li      s2, 0           # print loop
6:      bge     s2, s1, 8f
        slli    t0, s2, 2
        add     t0, t0, s0
        lw      a0, 0(t0)
        call    print_uint
        li      a0, 32          # space
        call    putc
        addi    s2, s2, 1
        j       6b
8:      li      a0, 10          # newline
        call    putc
        j       finish

# print_uint: a0 = unsigned value, printed in decimal (no newline).
print_uint:
        addi    sp, sp, -16
        sw      ra, 12(sp)
        li      t3, 0
        li      t4, 10
1:      mv      t0, a0
        li      t1, 0
2:      bltu    t0, t4, 3f
        addi    t0, t0, -10
        addi    t1, t1, 1
        j       2b
3:      addi    t0, t0, 48
        add     t2, sp, t3
        sb      t0, 0(t2)
        addi    t3, t3, 1
        mv      a0, t1
        bnez    a0, 1b
4:      addi    t3, t3, -1
        add     t2, sp, t3
        lbu     a0, 0(t2)
        call    putc
        bnez    t3, 4b
        lw      ra, 12(sp)
        addi    sp, sp, 16
        ret

# putc: a0 = byte to print.
putc:   lui     t1, 0x20
        sb      a0, 0(t1)
        ret

# finish: report PASS to the harness and halt.
finish: li      t0, 1
        lui     t1, 0x20
        sw      t0, 4(t1)
halt:   j       halt

        .data
        .align  2
array:  .word   42, 7, 99, 3, 18, 64, 1, 27, 85, 11, 50, 5

sim_programs/fib.source:
.section .text.init; .globl _start; _start: lui sp, 0x11;
        li s0, 20
        li a1, 0
        li a2, 1
1: beqz s0, 2f
        add a3, a1, a2
        mv a1, a2
        mv a2, a3
        addi s0, s0, -1
        j 1b
2: mv a0, a1
        call print_uint
        li t5, '\n'; lui t6, 0x20; sb t5, 0(t6);
        li t5, 1; lui t6, 0x20; sw t5, 4(t6); 9999: j 9999b;
print_uint: addi sp, sp, -16; li t3, 0; li t4, 10; 1: li t0, 0; 2: bltu a0, t4, 3f; addi a0, a0, -10; addi t0, t0, 1; j 2b; 3: addi a0, a0, 48; add t1, sp, t3; sb a0, 0(t1); addi t3, t3, 1; mv a0, t0; bnez a0, 1b; 4: addi t3, t3, -1; add t1, sp, t3; lbu a0, 0(t1); lui t2, 0x20; sb a0, 0(t2); bnez t3, 4b; addi sp, sp, 16; ret;

sim_programs/memcpy.source:
.section .text.init; .globl _start; _start: lui sp, 0x11;
        la a0, dst
        la a1, src
        li a2, 64
        call memcpy
        la t0, dst
        la t1, src
        li t2, 16
1: beqz t2, ok
        lw t3, 0(t0)
        lw t4, 0(t1)
        bne t3, t4, bad
        addi t0, t0, 4
        addi t1, t1, 4
        addi t2, t2, -1
        j 1b
ok: la a0, s_ok
        call print_str
        li t5, 1; lui t6, 0x20; sw t5, 4(t6); 9999: j 9999b;
bad: la a0, s_bad
        call print_str
        li t5, 3; lui t6, 0x20; sw t5, 4(t6); 9999: j 9999b;
memcpy: beqz a2, 2f
1: lbu t0, 0(a1)
        sb t0, 0(a0)
        addi a0, a0, 1
        addi a1, a1, 1
        addi a2, a2, -1
        bnez a2, 1b
2: ret
print_str: lui t1, 0x20; 1: lbu t0, 0(a0); beqz t0, 2f; sb t0, 0(t1); addi a0, a0, 1; j 1b; 2: ret;
        .data
        .align 2
src: .word 0x00000001, 0xdeadbeef, 0x80000000, 0x7fffffff, 0xffffffff, 0x12345678, 0x0badf00d, 0xcafebabe
        .word 0x0f0f0f0f, 0xf0f0f0f0, 0x00ff00ff, 0xff00ff00, 0x13579bdf, 0x2468ace0, 0x55aa55aa, 0xaa55aa55
dst: .space 64
s_ok: .asciz "OK\n"
s_bad: .asciz "FAIL\n"

sim_programs/primes.source:
.section .text.init; .globl _start; _start: lui sp, 0x11;
        la s0, sieve
        li s1, 60
        li t0, 0
1: bgt t0, s1, 2f
        add t1, s0, t0
        sb zero, 0(t1)
        addi t0, t0, 1
        j 1b
2: li s2, 2

        mv t2, s2
        li t3, 0
        mv t4, s2

        add t3, t3, t2
        addi t4, t4, -1
        j 4b

        lbu t5, 0(t1)
        bnez t5, 7f
        mv t0, t3
6: bgt t0, s1, 7f
        add t1, s0, t0
        li t5, 1
        sb t5, 0(t1)
        add t0, t0, s2
        j 6b
7: addi s2, s2, 1
        j 3b
8: li s2, 2
9: bgt s2, s1, 11f
        add t1, s0, s2
        lbu t5, 0(t1)
        bnez t5, 10f
        mv a0, s2
        call print_uint
        li t5, ' '; lui t6, 0x20; sb t5, 0(t6);
10: addi s2, s2, 1
        j 9b
11: li t5, '\n'; lui t6, 0x20; sb t5, 0(t6);
        li t5, 1; lui t6, 0x20; sw t5, 4(t6); 9999: j 9999b;
print_uint: addi sp, sp, -16; li t3, 0; li t4, 10; 1: li t0, 0; 2: bltu a0, t4, 3f; addi a0, a0, -10; addi t0, t0, 1; j 2b; 3: addi a0, a0, 48; add t1, sp, t3; sb a0, 0(t1); addi t3, t3, 1; mv a0, t0; bnez a0, 1b; 4: addi t3, t3, -1; add t1, sp, t3; lbu a0, 0(t1); lui t2, 0x20; sb a0, 0(t2); bnez t3, 4b; addi sp, sp, 16; ret;
        .bss

snippet/branches.source:

    li a0, 5
    li a1, -3
    beq a0, a1, fwd
    bne a0, a1, fwd
    blt a1, a0, fwd
    bge a0, a1, fwd
    bltu a0, a1, fwd

snippet/equ_and_expressions.source:
.equ BASE, 0x10000
.equ COUNT, 4 * 3 + 1
_start:
    li a0, BASE + COUNT
    li a1, (1 << 12) - 1
    addi a2, zero, COUNT - 1
    li a3, -(COUNT)
    li a4, 0xf0 | 0x0f
    li a5, 0xff & ~0x0f
    li a6, 7 % 4
    li a7, 'z' - 'a'
.data
    .word BASE + 4, end - start_data
start_data:
    .byte COUNT
end:
